title: Occam's razor and model selection
summary: Marginal likelihood as the common currency for fit and complexity; the size principle generalised to Bayes Occam's razor; the law of conservation of belief; Bayes factors for fair versus unfair coins and for curve fitting; the effect of unused parameters; cognitive phenomena read as model selection.

preparation.description: Read OCW lectures 17 and 18 (Controlling Complexity and Occam's Razor 1–2) and revisit lecture 13's 'Bayesian Occam's Razor' slide.

Read the web book's Occam's Razor chapter: the law of conservation of belief, the rectangle game, Bayes Occam's razor, model selection (fair or unfair coin; unused parameters; curve fitting). Reference-only.
